Method of Attack: Social engineering scam that scrambles text on hacked sites and prompts users to download a fake browser Font Pack
Downloading and executing obfuscated JavaScript (g.js) that connects to remote sites to download additional malicious files
Execution of client32.exe to gain remote access to infected computer
Impacted Systems: Windows computers (implied by .exe files and %AppData% folder usage)
Attack Vector: User visits hacked site via search engine, sees scrambled text and alert, clicks Update button to download Font_Update.exe
Execution of downloaded Font_Update.exe leading to further payload downloads and execution
Indicators of Compromise: Popup alert about missing browser font and prompt to download Font Pack
Files downloaded into tokipp folder under %AppData%
Use of Netsupport Manager remote access utility files
